description: Returns data {job_id, status: queued} after persisting the request. Read service_interface::job_service::get_job with that exact job_id; schedule another read while queued or processing. Only a terminal successful job provides the original complete response in job.result (the original data is job.result.data); failures preserve the original response in job.result and the error in job.error. Do not repeat the operation because its completion has not been read. Runs plugin::agent_messaging_plugin::refresh_model_capability_catalog once with trigger='cron' (live fetches from the two Artificial Analysis sources), then classifies the model capability catalog ok/warning/critical. CRITICAL: the refresh raised or returned a failure, recorded any failed source, no cell is accepted, or a run without successful renewal leaves the oldest accepted cell older than the staleness window the cells themselves carry (the tightest staleness_window_hours, read from the catalog and never hard-coded). WARNING: the run renewed no accepted cell, or a run without successful renewal leaves the oldest accepted cell older than 48 hours (capped at the window). A successful renewal is the current-run health signal even when historical accepted cells are not renewed; historical_unrenewed_cell_count and a stale advisory keep those cells, their measured_at timestamps and selector staleness visible. On a severity TRANSITION (status differs from the last recorded status, including the recovery back to ok) it writes the new status to its durable marker (the platform_health_plugin key-value 'model_capability_guard:last_status') and logs one line: ERROR for critical, WARNING for warning, INFO for ok. The line names the run counts, the oldest accepted cell age and the failed sources, and says the selector still works from the last accepted readings. Independently of severity, a refresh with zero readings or a failed leaderboard source sends a durable advisory to the solet-local Main role (the title-cased solet name followed by -Main) once per UTC day. The notice gives the day, run ID when available, reason, counts and oldest accepted cell age. Failed notice delivery is logged and returned in advisories while selection continues with the last accepted readings. The messaging plugin being unavailable raises instead of reporting ok. Not discoverable via search (is_discoverable=False) because it reaches the network; the daily schedule fires check_model_capability_catalog_cron.
embedding_description: Catalog renewal guard: refreshes live sources, classifies ok/warning/critical from failures, renewal, and the catalog staleness window, counts historical cells not renewed, logs severity changes, and notifies the local Main role daily on zero readings or leaderboard failure.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: job_id and status=queued. Retrieve the exact job; the former final response is in job.result. status (ok|warning|critical), reasons, refresh_failure, readings_gathered, cells_accepted, cells_conflicted, cells_unchanged, sources_failed, renewed (bool), historical_unrenewed_cell_count (accepted cells whose measured_at did not advance during this run), accepted_cell_count, oldest_cell_age_hours, staleness_window_hours, transitioned (bool -- true when the severity changed on this call and the new status was recorded and logged). reasons includes the stale historical-cell advisory when applicable. advisories lists any failure to send or record the daily operator notice.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: A queued receipt confirms acceptance only. Retrieve the terminal job before presenting the outcome. Lead with status, then the cell counts and oldest_cell_age_hours against staleness_window_hours. Report a recorded severity change when transitioned is true and surface any notice advisory.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: The check failed before it could classify the catalog: agent_messaging_plugin could not be resolved, the state service returned a non-completed status, or a catalog row was malformed. Distinct from a completed call that reports status=critical because the refresh itself failed, which is a normal, fully-handled outcome.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: A raised exception means missing orchestrator wiring, a state-service outage, or an unreadable catalog row; it says nothing about whether the catalog is fresh.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Confirm platform startup finished and the state-management provider is healthy before calling again. Not retryable by the platform: a retry would run a second live refresh.
